cmd:
mkdir -p /root/nocodb-data; if [ ! -f /root/nocodb-pass.txt ]; then openssl rand -base64 15 | tr -d '
' > /root/nocodb-pass.txt; chmod 600 /root/nocodb-pass.txt; fi; nohup sh -c 'docker pull nocodb/nocodb:latest > /root/nocodb-deploy.log 2>&1 && docker run -d --name nocodb --restart unless-stopped -p 8080:8080 -e NC_ADMIN_EMAIL=irynakarmazina@gmail.com -e NC_ADMIN_PASSWORD="$(cat /root/nocodb-pass.txt)" -v /root/nocodb-data:/usr/app/data nocodb/nocodb:latest >> /root/nocodb-deploy.log 2>&1 && echo DEPLOY_DONE >> /root/nocodb-deploy.log || echo DEPLOY_FAIL >> /root/nocodb-deploy.log' >/dev/null 2>&1 & echo BACKGROUND_STARTED
